note: Each line below is a separate fact with its own source; none of them says the stake alone paid for the builds.

stake.source: read from a NEAR mainnet node on 2026-11-13: a stake call from the account with 3,045 NEAR attached
stake.eur_source: Clemens, value at purchase; not derived from a price feed

estimate.source: NEAR AI's estimate for this stake, as told to the collective. An estimate, not credits received.

credit_rate.text: NEAR AI publishes a formula, not a fixed rate: one credit is one US dollar of usage; staking rewards (not the staked NEAR) pay for inference; monthly usage covered = staked NEAR × NEAR price × reward rate ÷ 12. The calculator's reward rate of 4.78% a year is labelled an illustrative default, not a live quote.

inference_spend.source: sum of the receipts in this repository
inference_spend.note: computed by the app from data/runs, not stored here
